record.reason: Full text adds force-aware modality routing with an MoE for contact-rich robotic manipulation, but the paper centers on robot control and does not identify sparse-compute, faster inference, lower memory, or reduced latency as an objective. MoE architecture creates only a weak speculative systems connection.
record.title: ForceVLA: Enhancing VLA Models with a Force-aware MoE for Contact-rich Manipulation
